admission.queueMode: one admitted idea at a time on the local device until concurrency is independently proven
admission.start: When a concrete game request is accepted by the harness, before any subsequent queue wait/loading/inference. Future batch slots are not game requests until instantiated.
admission.capabilityDevelopment: Complete and validate shared capabilities before admitting an idea; missing behavior discovered during generation fails that idea rather than pausing time.
admission.clock: Persist UTC start/deadline and monotonic elapsed while process lives; deadline checks are conservative on resume or inconsistent clocks. Never grant additional time after clock rollback.
admission.atomicAcceptance: Under writer lock: re-read candidate/rule hashes, required verdicts and deadline; publish acceptance atomically only if all pass and now < deadline.
admission.batchDeadline: No 25-minute batch limit; no infinite unattended replacement loop. Stall criteria below block further admission.
admission.qualification: All required per-game evidence and atomic qualification must finish before the original deadline. Qualified immutable candidates remain provisional until the paired Review independently audits them.
admission.review: Batch audit may inspect frozen timely evidence after the deadline; it cannot repair expired candidates or complete missing per-game checks. Revoked slots need new, materially different replacement ideas with explicit lineage.

guards.ready: Plan goals require resolved versioned inputs and a bounded work packet; their output decisions may remain to be resolved. Build/Review goals require all mandatory prerequisite decisions and phase inputs resolved. Completion always requires phase-specific checks.
guards.complete: Phase-specific acceptance evidence passes; no unresolved blocking findings.
guards.retry: Append attempt/revision and reason; preserve failures. A goal may resume but an expired game attempt cannot.
guards.revoke: Mark affected complete goals needs_review and block dependent admission; preserve unaffected accepted artifacts.

queue.lease: Atomic claim includes owner and process identity; recover only after confirming prior owner ended. Persist checkpoint before external operation and deduplicate by operationId.
queue.rework: Finding owns goalId, featureId, candidateRevision and required checks. Reopen its smallest owning step rather than restarting queue.

improvement.keep: Targeted failing assertion becomes PASS or a frozen graded criterion improves; all protected hard gates hold. Equal scores/no evidence are not improvement. Final baseline gates remain mandatory.
improvement.revert: Restore baseline configuration and shared version references; record patch signature and failed assertions. Do not modify prior artifact.

locks.invalidate: Changed feature plus affected transitive dependents; scene/camera/global feedback changes include readability and novelty checks.
locks.reuse: Only exact-version evidence outside invalidated closure; final whole-game checks are mandatory.

noProgress.rule: Do not repeat identical (finding,baseline,patch) signatures. If every currently supported repair alternative for the unresolved finding is exhausted or controller returns to a seen unchanged state, fail idea with NO_PROGRESS.
noProgress.batchStall: After three consecutive failures of the same capability/check cause without a verified shared correction, pause affected admission for diagnosis. This is a recovery trigger, not an improvement-pass or campaign quota.
noProgress.recovery: Record failure cause, capability and evidence; fix shared source/catalog/controller; reproduce the failing case and pass an independent probe before resuming; revalidate affected dependencies. No cosmetic deadline-reset replacements.

retention.candidateArtifacts: Best verified and current candidate; retain additional artifacts only when necessary for acceptance provenance or unresolved finding reproduction.
retention.spine: Accepted decisions, changes, locks, compact findings, usage telemetry and evidence refs; no raw reasoning or repeated full catalogs.

improvement.scheduling: Before a repair, compare remaining time to measured final-validation duration for this profile class. If there is insufficient time to validate another revision, validate best candidate immediately; if required checks cannot finish before deadline, fail idea. Never omit checks or extend time.

planner.role: Resolve interpretation and propose one bounded repair.

writerReviewer.role: Write/edit structured presentation selections; inspect actual rendered evidence. Image review cannot validate audio or gameplay alone.

enforcement: Validate response shape, candidate revision, allowed paths, values, compatibility and deadline before applying.
Reject executable code, commands, arbitrary dependencies, invented capabilities or changed acceptance rules.
Retrieve only referenced relevant catalog entries/evidence; no entire-catalog prompts.
Invalid responses receive specific local errors only while deadline and untried correction paths remain.
Contradictory reviews remain unresolved; require identified evidence/independent check, never turn positive prose into PASS.
llmContract.perRequestLimits: Choose max output/context to fit schema and loaded model; no cumulative token or fixed call allowance. Timeout never exceeds remaining idea time.
llmContract.repairSemantics: A propose response needs at least one allowed change and one known affected check. Non-propose responses must have zero changes. Validator enforces this plus exact revision and allowlists.
llmContract.pathSyntax: Patch paths are exact JSON Pointers into the current resolved profile. Controller supplies allowed pointers, validates candidate revision and rejects unknown or protected paths. Catalog fragments target an intermediate map, not arbitrary game code.

campaignExecution.sequence: Preserve G01-G33 and eleven Plan/Build/Review cycles; reopen the original owning goal for rework and block dependent advancement.
campaignExecution.completion: All 33 goals complete plus ten reviewed disjoint batches of 100 active accepted games; pilots, historical, expired, failed, duplicate and revoked entries excluded.
campaignExecution.resume: Inspect current source, evidence hashes and process handles; preserve valid work, expire overdue ideas, recover dead leases and resume earliest incomplete dependency. A checkpoint does not schedule execution.
campaignExecution.milestone: A pilot, passing check, working UI or batch is progress, not campaign completion.
campaignExecution.humanReview: Freeze exact human obligations before admission. Calibrate subjective rubrics before batch generation; no blanket per-game human gate is implied. Required candidate human evidence must arrive within its original deadline.
campaignExecution.externalBlocker: Continue independent work within the current dependency boundary; record exact missing external input only when no independent action remains.
campaignExecution.pushPolicy: User authorized validated incremental commits and ordinary pushes to origin main. Preserve unrelated work; never force-push.

layerComposition.complexity: Deeper connected consequences and meaningful choices; never merely more objects or larger parameters.
layerComposition.ablation: Each claimed gameplay layer names an observable decision/outcome and a suppress-or-perturb probe. Presentation layers use distinct readability/style/event-feedback obligations.
layerComposition.expansion: Children expose compatible next choices; cycles and unsupported leaves are explicit rejections. No unrestricted Cartesian-product enumeration.

resolutionPreference.matching: Use typed requirements, offered capabilities, parameter bounds and compatibility rules to match lists before inference; preserve the independent concept roll.
resolutionPreference.seedExpansion: Use recorded seeds to vary supported selections, child branches, parameter ranges, spatial relationships and progression. Reproduce with catalog/compiler/collection versions; new seeds alone do not establish novelty.
resolutionPreference.dataBeforeCode: Prefer adding or improving reusable option data, mappings, supported parameter ranges and compatible child combinations before implementing another mechanic or template. Eligibility still requires existing behavior and evidence.

gapRouting.catalog: An existing capability can express the intent: extend catalog mapping and verify the resulting composition.
gapRouting.capability: No relevant supported combination can express the required behavior: record evidence and implement the smallest reusable domain extension under its owning goal.
gapRouting.interpretation: Supported alternatives remain ambiguous or a bounded composition/presentation detail is unresolved: give the designated local model the matched choices and exact gap.

resolutionPreference.modelBoundary: Models resolve bounded gaps and review actual evidence; they do not replace catalog matching, invent implementations, change protected intent or generate arbitrary scripts.
resolutionPreference.stopping: Search relevant compatible branches within the idea deadline; do not require exhaustive enumeration of a combinatorial space. Record attempted choices and rejection reasons compactly.
resolutionPreference.evidence: Distinguish catalog/list limitations from engine limitations using matched option IDs, rejected combinations, missing required ports/behavior, and resulting player-visible consequence.

criteria: Keyboard WASD/arrows, E/Space contextual action, Escape pause, R restart; buttons Play/Resume/Back reachable by keyboard.
Opposing inputs cancel; key release, blur and hidden page clear held inputs. Resume is explicit.
Verify 1100x780 gameplay and 390x844 library; touch/gamepad gameplay is not an advertised input mode.
inputSupport.positiveCase: Reviewed pilots pause through 180 seconds of accelerated time and explicitly resume.
inputSupport.negativeCase: Held input after blur, automatic resume or inaccessible Play fails.
inputSupport.rationale: Freeze the tested desktop input surface before adding new devices.

criteria: Use metres, fixed 0.05-second ticks, and finite bounded coordinates. Walking actor footprint radius 0.4m; vehicle footprint must match its oriented rendered body.
Traverse every mandatory route with actual inputs; clearance is footprint plus 0.15m per side. Test corners, speed maxima, closed gates and opened gates.
Collision penetration <=0.05m; interaction occurs only inside the capability range and correct state. Visibility is checked from the actual camera, not an overhead debug view.
spatialTolerances.positiveCase: Courier rejects wrong receiver; Rally route traversal follows rendered track geometry.
spatialTolerances.negativeCase: Point-only support that lets vehicle body cross a wall, unreachable target or through-wall action fails.
spatialTolerances.rationale: Current pilots establish routes and point checks; footprint collision and visibility witnesses are explicit G02 work.

criteria: Complete two successful sessions; cover each declared distinct ending plus a loss and restart.
Compare reset state to baseline excluding intentional persistent records; no duplicate rewards, cargo or event subscriptions.
Use accelerated traces for logic and separate real-time tests for timing/performance. Required final checks run on the exact immutable candidate before its original 1500-second deadline.
sessionCoverage.positiveCase: Five development previews complete twice, lose by timeout and restart.
sessionCoverage.negativeCase: Finishing by directly setting objective state, a frozen timer or a restart retaining cargo fails.
sessionCoverage.rationale: Existing keyboard witnesses provide controls; they do not prove all future compositions.

criteria: Roll independent concepts before genre interpretation; preserve original IDs and expansion choices.
For every selected concept store a causal chain: property -> domain/parameter/port -> player action -> visible state consequence.
Disable or perturb the claimed effect in a validation-only probe: a declared reachable state, player decision or outcome must change. Labels and story text are removed for this comparison.
One unimplemented or purely decorative mandatory concept fails the candidate; no dropping a rolled concept to make it pass.
conceptRubric.positiveCase: A transfer unlocks a shorter route: disabling transfer keeps it closed and changes route choice.
conceptRubric.negativeCase: Growth in the title of an otherwise unchanged racing lap fails.
conceptRubric.rationale: Existing pilot concepts are naming context only; these are build acceptance cases, not claims they already pass.

criteria: Capture first view, available action, consequence, peak clutter and ending at 1100x780.
Required instructions >=16 CSS pixels and 4.5:1 text contrast; distinguish target/state using shape, position or motion as well as color.
From each capture the reviewer identifies the current objective, actionable target and visible consequence. No mandatory actor/target occluded by labels or HUD.
Any uncertain required observation is NEEDS_REVIEW. Conditional human review must finish before idea deadline; otherwise fail idea without blocking the campaign.
readabilityRubric.positiveCase: Fixed Courier marker exposes the body; raised Rally gates expose car and road.
readabilityRubric.negativeCase: Earlier Courier YOU marker hid the body; earlier Rally gate beam and shadows obscured the player.
readabilityRubric.rationale: Actual independent rejection overrode model PASS, so a single image opinion is insufficient.

criteria: Define shape language, material/light response, camera framing and motion/feedback identity as reusable capability settings.
Inspect first-action-consequence-ending and crowded frames; no z fighting, severe shadow acne, clipped target, floating mandatory object or unreadable silhouettes.
Player action and success/failure have visible feedback within 100ms; audio confirmation needs actual output/event evidence plus mute behavior, not a screenshot claim.
Verify reduced-effects mode preserves required information. A palette swap or a generic primitive scene alone does not satisfy a distinct polished presentation.
presentationRubric.positiveCase: Raised gate beam and corrected shadow bias remove observed Rally occlusion and surface artifacts.
presentationRubric.negativeCase: Rally version with shadow acne or HUD contrast loss fails even when the VL model says PASS.
presentationRubric.rationale: Use demonstrated defects as negatives while retaining high fidelity as an outcome requiring further shared presentation work.

criteria: Both visual and interaction novelty are mandatory and independently recorded.

Canonicalize IDs and ignore title, prose and palette. Compare against all accepted signatures; inspect the five nearest behavior neighbors and five nearest visual neighbors, plus within-batch neighbors.
Interaction proof names a different consequential choice, timing skill or causal relationship and demonstrates it in paired traces; different graph IDs/counts alone fail.

Visual proof requires two non-color differences among spatial organization, recognizable geometry, player framing, material/light organization and event-linked motion. Compare matched player-view states and grayscale silhouettes.
Exact duplicates and relabeled duplicates fail. Near-neighbor uncertainty is NEEDS_REVIEW; do not use a distance threshold as sole PASS evidence.
noveltyRubric.positiveCase: Transport through branching rooms, first-person reconfigured flow and chase steering are held-out contrast briefs, each still needing actual traces/images.
noveltyRubric.negativeCase: Same Rally track/actions with another seed/title/palette fails; changed track curvature alone does not automatically establish interaction novelty.
noveltyRubric.rationale: A conjunctive evidence rubric permits new combinations while rejecting cosmetic variation.

criteria: Target Apple M2 Pro using headed Chromium ANGLE Metal, WebGL2, 1100x780 CSS pixels, deviceScaleFactor 1. Software rasterization is never hardware proof.
Measure after 2-second warmup for 60 seconds of actual inputs including declared peak interactions: median frame <=16.7ms, p95 <=20ms, max <=100ms.

Local cold navigation to ready <=5000ms; measured input-to-visible feedback p95 <=100ms. JS heap peak <=256MiB and post-restart retained growth <=10MiB across three restarts. Record renderer, browser version, settings and workload.
Generation and player remain mutually exclusive. Device measurement unavailable or incomplete means no qualification; no automatic lowering to software-renderer performance.
deviceBudgets.positiveCase: Headed Metal stationary probe: median 8.3ms, p95 9.8ms, 601 samples. Supports backend feasibility only.
deviceBudgets.negativeCase: SwiftShader control p95 40.9ms fails the hardware target and is not interchangeable evidence.
deviceBudgets.rationale: Measured backend exists; explicit moving-load, memory and input tests belong to G02.

criteria: Record why to replay and the supported choice/skill that changes the outcome.

Two full sessions on equivalent rules/course/runtime; compare a deliberately different approach. For time improvement require >=0.25 seconds and >=1 percent, not timing noise. Non-time strategies require a different declared cost, route or resource outcome.
Personal best survives restart/reload and compares only matching identity; changed rules or runtime must not reuse it.
Two identical courier/valve routes with a saved number, cosmetic reseeding or more objects are not replay evidence.
replayRubric.positiveCase: Three Rally controls show different braking approaches improve times well above 0.25s and 1%.
replayRubric.negativeCase: Identical valve sequences with identical consequences fail replay even if both runs win.
replayRubric.rationale: Keep the verified record system but require a meaningful reason to change play.

domainContract.instance: id, capabilityId, capabilityVersion, settings, transform, sourceOptionIds
domainContract.settings: Closed JSON schema per trusted capability; finite ranges and defaults; reject unknown fields.
domainContract.ports: Typed state snapshots for position/number/boolean; typed queued events for interactions. No model-authored callbacks.
domainContract.connections: Explicit source instance/port to destination instance/port; exact payload type match; required ports bound once unless declared fan-in.
domainContract.schedule: Fixed 0.05-second tick; topologically ordered zero-delay connections; stateful feedback must declare one-tick delay. Delivery order stable by instance ID.
domainContract.composition: Trusted factory functions instantiate NexusEngine domains; Three.js presenters read domain state; no arbitrary script strings.
domainContract.provenance: Seed, original concepts, chosen properties/options, source/rule hashes, causal contribution map and expected witnesses.

modelResolution.planner: LFM2.5 Thinking 1.2B; enum-bounded residual interpretation after list resolution.
modelResolution.writer: LFM2.5 VL 3B; supported profile/editorial fields and actual-image observations.
modelResolution.rejected: The port-design call chose immediate recursion. Harness rejects it against cycle constraints; deterministic next-tick wiring fills the gap.

reviewPolicy.human: No universal per-game human gate. Apply frozen observable criteria automatically and through actual-image review; unresolved comprehension/novelty cases require review within the original deadline or fail. Initial baseline calibration cannot be inferred from model confidence.
reviewPolicy.acceptance: G02 qualifications are not factory collection acceptance. G03 independent review gates batching; each later review controls its paired batch.
reviewPolicy.time: 25 minutes per original admitted idea; campaign has no aggregate time/token/pass cap.

orderedWork.operation: Define strict capability settings, typed ports, dependencies and versioned implementation/probe references. Map source-present options first; keep unproven capabilities ineligible.

Expand independent abstract concept properties using seeded lists, resolve compatible layers, then compile explicit domain instances and connections. Models fill only unresolved bounded interpretation. Reject empty contribution, unknown capability, type conflict, unreachable objective and unsupported cycle.
